Purpose: the plant's seeded noise path (sim/plant/src/noise) must give bit-identical normals on every host, so its
log, sin and cos cannot be the platform's libm. These are the only maths routines that path calls, plus IEEE sqrt.

Every file below is UNMODIFIED; its path in the tarball is the path under this directory (log_data.h, libm.h,
fp_arch.h included as in the tarball; fp_arch.h is the tarball's arch/generic one, which is empty). The files are
the transitive closure of log, sin and cos, so no call leaves this set:
  log.c -> log_data.c, __math_divzero.c, __math_invalid.c
  sin.c, cos.c -> __sin.c, __cos.c, __rem_pio2.c -> __rem_pio2_large.c -> floor.c, scalbn.c
The build (sim/plant/src/noise/CMakeLists.txt) renames the five public symbols with -D (log, sin, cos, floor, scalbn
become marv_musl_*), compiles as C with -ffp-contract=off and -U__FP_FAST_FMA (so log.c takes its portable
non-fused branch on every target), without -ffast-math.
